about: The street-lighting standard (docs/world-standards/towns.md): every town street and every road near a town carries lanterns. Read by tools/town-lights.mts (plan/check/apply) and by `zonegen status` (row `town <name>: lights`). Schema with every field described: streetLightingSchema in tools/town-lights-rule.mts. A project may replace this file with authoring/street-lights.json.
